items.title: Nirmal Bang initiates Sterlite Tech at Buy, Rs 1,340 target; stock hits record Rs 989.70
items.text: Per Univest's report, Nirmal Bang initiated coverage of Sterlite Technologies with a Buy rating and a Rs 1,340 target, about 35% upside from the 5 October close. Whalesbook reports the shares hit a record Rs 989.70 and market cap passed Rs 50,000 crore, with the stock up roughly 875% year to date. Univest puts the P/E at about 65x on annualised Q1 profit and notes contract values are estimates that depend on periodic purchase orders. The call shows broker coverage widening after the $1.2 bn hyperscaler deal, but valuation is already stretched.

items.title: HFCL rallies 12.59% in a week with three straight 5% upper circuits
items.text: HFCL rose from Rs 211.35 to Rs 237.95 between 28 Sep and 1 Oct 2026, hitting the 5% upper circuit on 29 Sep, 30 Sep and 1 Oct, while the Sensex fell 3.20%. It had dropped 3% on 28 Sep to an intraday low of Rs 200.80 on a weak BSE Telecom index. Volume on 1 Oct was 9.21 million shares, but later delivery volumes fell, which MarketsMojo reads as more speculative trading. The move shows how volatile the heavily re-rated fibre names remain.
